map.输入相位差 Δφ（度）与角频率差 Δω（rad/s），求群时延 τ_g，用于滤波: Enter the phase difference dphi (degrees) and angular frequency difference domega (rad/s) to find the group delay tau_g, for filter and system analysis.
map.输入相位差 Δφ（度）与角频率差 Δω（rad/s），求群时延。: Enter the phase difference dphi (degrees) and angular frequency difference domega (rad/s) to find the group delay.
map.相频斜率 −dφ/dω 得群延迟，衡量各频率分量延时一致性。: The slope of the phase response -dphi/domega gives the group delay, measuring how consistently each frequency component is delayed.
map.：群延迟 tg = −(90×π/180) / 1000 = −(π/2)/10: : Group delay tg = -(90 x pi/180)/1000 = -(pi/2)/1000, about -1.571x10^-3 s, about -1.57 ms.
map.：若相位随频率线性（斜率恒定），则群延迟为常数，信号无失真。: : If phase varies linearly with frequency (constant slope), the group delay is constant and the signal is undistorted.

map.群延迟为负有问题吗？: Is a negative group delay a problem?
map.物理可实现系统群延迟非负；示例中符号取决于相位定义方向，绝对值才有意义。: Physically realizable systems have non-negative group delay; in the example the sign depends on the phase definition direction, so only the absolute value is meaningful.
map.群延迟与相位延迟区别？: What is the difference between group delay and phase delay?
map.相位延迟是单频相移/频率，群延迟是相频斜率，决定包络延时。: Phase delay is the single-frequency phase shift divided by frequency, while group delay is the slope of the phase response and determines envelope delay.
